name: 30330-specdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; draft_tensor_parallel_size 1.
architecture: Dense bf16 decoder, LlamaForCausalLM: 8.03 B parameters, ~16.1 GB of bf16 weights, 128 KiB of KV per token; the EAGLE3 head adds one decoder layer, 0.85 GB, loaded bf16 with the target.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 640 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets; prompt exactly 1024 tokens and output exactly 256 (min = max on both), greedy (`temperature: 0.0`), static seed 30330. The vllm_python backend sets ignore_eos=True whenever max_tokens is set, so every request emits exactly 256 tokens.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant with draft-model acceleration, answering 64 concurrent page-length prompts with fixed-length replies on one GPU.
launch:
# WRITE EVERY VALUE ON ONE LINE. The loader is a flat reader: it drops every line starting with a
# space, so re-flowing `speculative-config` into a block mapping silently starts the engine with no
# speculative decoding at all.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1, "max_model_len": 2048}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 64
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
dtype: bfloat16
enforce-eager: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
